value.rationale: The union of two coordinate lines is a canonical split quadratic cone, and a minimal natural example where affine symmetries fail to act transitively. Determining its exact sharp arbitrary-weight Fourier synthesis constant and complete extremizers addresses the motivating article's symmetry limitation, demonstrates an explicit central-sign phase transition and identifies the sharp q^(-1/4) endpoint decay. This is not merely an indicator substitution or a tabulated extension norm.
